firstPersonFov.label: First-person FOV
firstPersonFov.description: The default immersive viewpoint for the continuous XR story.
firstPersonFov.transitionPrompt: The viewpoint smoothly returns to a first-person eye-level POV with a wide field of view.
firstPersonFov.correctionPrompt: Restore the camera to the same first-person eye-level POV and wide field of view, continuing the same uninterrupted take.

closeUp.label: Close-up
closeUp.description: An intimate view emphasizing a face or small object.
closeUp.transitionPrompt: The camera slowly zooms into an eye-level close-up with shallow depth of field.
closeUp.correctionPrompt: Restore the camera to the same eye-level close-up with shallow depth of field, continuing the same uninterrupted take.

wideEstablishing.label: Wide establishing
wideEstablishing.description: A broad view emphasizing the subject's relationship to the environment.
wideEstablishing.transitionPrompt: The camera slowly pans into an eye-level wide shot that reveals the surrounding environment in deep focus.
wideEstablishing.correctionPrompt: Restore the camera to the same eye-level wide shot with deep depth of field, continuing the same uninterrupted take.

overhead.label: Overhead
overhead.description: A top-down view emphasizing movement and spatial layout.
overhead.transitionPrompt: The camera rises smoothly into a static overhead medium-wide view with deep depth of field.
overhead.correctionPrompt: Restore the camera to the same static overhead medium-wide view with deep depth of field, continuing the same uninterrupted take.
